summary: Iteration 27 backend regression suite: CV scoring formula (NPS%/10 + promoters*1 + detractors*-2) + delta-math for CV-input edits + new 1920x1080 PNG / PDF snapshot endpoints. 12/12 tests PASS. All main-agent-stated behaviors verified against live Q2 2026 data: (a) PUT with nps_score=50 on Treyanna recalculated cv_score to exactly 6.0 (50*0.10 + 1*1 + 0*-2), shifted total_score by (6.0 - 11.0) = -5.0 delta exactly (from 94.46 to 89.46), set nps_manual_override=true, and the snapshot.employees record mirrored the v2 record field-for-field (cv_score, total_score, nps_manual_override all aligned). (b) nps_contribution=5.0 + cv_raw_points=1.0 decomposed correctly. (c) Second test with nps=80+promoters=5 produced cv=13.0 exactly and delta-math preserved. (d) Name-only PUT kept total_score and cv_score unchanged (no CV recompute). (e) liquor_sales=999 triggered the full POS rebuild branch (weighted_score + total_score both recomputed). (f) GET /api/v2/full-rankings/2026/Q2/snapshot-png returned 200 image/png, size exactly 1920x1080, palette colors (#33CC33, #FFFF00, #FF0000, #0C769E, white, navy) found in top-40 colors on right-half crop. (g) snapshot-pdf returned 200 application/pdf with %PDF magic bytes. (h) Both endpoints return 404 for empty Q4 2026. (i) Regressions green: /api/qr/leaderboard-data 200; nickname CRUD at /api/v2/snapshot-workflow/nicknames (GET/POST/DELETE) works with 31+ defaults including treyanna/thaddeus; RT parser surface reachable. Treyanna restored to baseline (nps=100, cv=11.0, total=94.46) after test run.

minor.issue: Idempotent restore to nps_score=100 (same value) still flips nps_manual_override=true. Not a bug per se (any CV-input PUT intentionally sets the flag), but worth noting: a pure no-op PUT still marks the row as manually overridden. Agent note said this is expected/idempotent, confirmed not breaking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_employee (line ~2480-2857) correctly splits delta-math vs full-rebuild branches via the `full_rebuild` flag at line 2694. The delta-math branch at 2696-2726 correctly uses (new_cv - old_cv) + (new_rt - old_rt) + (new_bonus - old_bonus) to shift total_score, and sets `settings_doc = None` as a sentinel to skip the legacy rebuild block. This works but the sentinel pattern is fragile - if a future edit accidentally reads settings_doc after line 2726 it will NoneType-error. Recommend an explicit early-continue or a `rebuild_done` boolean instead of overloading settings_doc.

server.py line 2604-2605: nps_override_fields intersection marks nps_manual_override=True on ANY PUT touching nps_score/cv_promoters/cv_passives/cv_detractors - even if the value is unchanged. Consider comparing to emp_doc before flipping to avoid noisy overrides on idempotent PUTs (e.g., the reset path in our tests re-flags to true even though the effective value is identical). Low priority.
